q_src: What was the name of Nellie McKay's record label when Pretty Little Head was released?
q_tgt: Apa nama label rekaman Nellie McKay saat Pretty Little Head dirilis?
a_src: Nellie McKay released "Pretty Little Head" on her own record label, titled Hungry Mouse.
a_tgt: Album "Pretty Little Head" oleh Nellie McKay awalnya dirilis secara independen melalui label rekaman miliknya sendiri, Hungry Mouse, setelah terjadi perselisihan dengan label sebelumnya, Columbia Records.
c_src: Pretty Little Head is the second album by singer Nellie McKay. It was released October 31, 2006, on Nellie's own Hungry Mouse label. It features duets with Cyndi Lauper ("Beecharmer") and k.d. lang ("We Had It Right"). Other songs include "Columbia Is Bleeding", "Cupcake" ("...about gay marriage..."), and "The Big One" ("...about a tenant's rights activist...").Pretty Little Head was originally set to be released October 18, 2005. The release date was subsequently delayed until December 27, 2005 and finally January 3, 2006.However, McKay announced on December 19, 2005, that she had left Columbia/Sony Records after a dispute over the length of the upcoming album. Just over two weeks following this announcement, a New York Times article surfaced stating McKay said she had been dropped by Columbia Records.The album was being marketed and manufactured on the SpinArt Records label until the label's bankruptcy in 2007.
c_tgt:
Pretty Little Head adalah album kedua oleh penyanyi Nellie McKay. Album ini dirilis pada 31 Oktober 2006, oleh label Hungry Mouse milik Nellie sendiri. Album ini menampilkan duet dengan Cyndi Lauper ("Beecharmer") dan k.d. lang ("We Had It Right"). Lagu-lagu lainnya termasuk "Columbia Is Bleeding", "Cupcake" ("...tentang pernikahan gay..."), dan "The Big One" ("...tentang aktivis hak penyewa...").

Pretty Little Head awalnya akan dirilis pada 18 Oktober 2005. Tanggal rilis kemudian ditunda hingga 27 Desember 2005 dan akhirnya 3 Januari 2006. Namun, McKay mengumumkan pada 19 Desember 2005, bahwa ia telah meninggalkan Columbia/Sony Records setelah perselisihan mengenai durasi album yang akan datang. Lebih dari dua minggu setelah pengumuman ini, sebuah artikel New York Times muncul yang menyatakan bahwa McKay mengaku telah dikeluarkan oleh Columbia Records.

Album ini dipasarkan dan diproduksi oleh label SpinArt Records hingga label tersebut bangkrut pada tahun 2007.

q_src: How long does a Rector of Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore remain in office?
q_tgt: Berapa lama seorang Rektor Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore menjabat?
a_src: The Rector of the Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore typically serves a four-year term. However, the exact terms can vary based on the university's statutes or any amendments made to the governing rules, so it's always a good idea to check the latest guidelines from the university for the most accurate information.
a_tgt: Di Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore di Italia, jabatan rektor biasanya berlangsung selama empat tahun. Namun, rektor dapat dipilih kembali untuk masa jabatan berikutnya. Kebijakan mengenai masa jabatan rektor dapat berbeda-beda bergantung pada peraturan dan tradisi yang berlaku di universitas tersebut.
c_src: The Rector of Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore (Italian: Magnifico Rettore, commonly known just as the Rettore) is the highest academic authority of the university.The Rector legally represents the University, convenes and chairs the Board of Directors, the Executive Committee, the Academic Senate of the University and the Advisory Board of the Agostino Gemelli University Polyclinic. The rector may appoint one or more Vice Rectors to whom he can delegate the exercise of certain functions. Rectors remain in office for four years and can be re-elected for no more than two consecutive terms.== History ==Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore was inaugurated on 7th of December 1921 and began operations with two faculties: Philosophy and Social Sciences. Agostino Gemelli was the rector of Cattolica until his death, widely teaching through the School of Law, Political Sciences, Humanities, Business and Economics in the Milan campus and at the School of Agriculture, in Piacenza.Upon the death of Francesco Vito, Ezio Franceschini was elected as the third rector (1965-1968) and had to face the rise of student protests in 1968. Some professors found his pursuit of dialogue with the protesting students inadequate and, taking advantage of his poor health, replaced him in the rectory with Giuseppe Lazzati, which followed a line of more decisive break with the demands for renewal.Lorenzo Ornaghi has been serving as the Italy's Minister of Culture in the Monti cabinet since 16 November 2011. After the appointment of Professor Lorenzo Ornaghi as minister, all the powers and functions belonging to the office of rector were entrusted to the vicar vice chancellor, prof.
c_tgt:
Rektor Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore (Bahasa Italia: Magnifico Rettore, umumnya dikenal sebagai Rettore) adalah otoritas akademik tertinggi di universitas. Rektor secara hukum mewakili Universitas, mengadakan dan memimpin Dewan Direksi, Komite Eksekutif, Senat Akademik Universitas dan Dewan Penasihat Poliklinik Universitas Agostino Gemelli. Rektor dapat menunjuk satu atau lebih Wakil Rektor yang dapat didelegasikan untuk menjalankan fungsi-fungsi tertentu. Rektor menjabat selama empat tahun dan dapat dipilih kembali untuk tidak lebih dari dua masa jabatan berturut-turut.

== Sejarah ==
Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore diresmikan pada tanggal 7 Desember 1921 dan mulai beroperasi dengan dua fakultas: Filsafat dan Ilmu Sosial. Agostino Gemelli adalah rektor Cattolica sampai kematiannya, mengajar secara luas melalui Fakultas Hukum, Ilmu Politik, Humaniora, Bisnis dan Ekonomi di kampus Milan dan di Fakultas Pertanian, di Piacenza.

Setelah kematian Francesco Vito, Ezio Franceschini terpilih sebagai rektor ketiga (1965-1968) dan harus menghadapi munculnya protes mahasiswa pada tahun 1968. Beberapa profesor merasa bahwa upayanya untuk berdialog dengan mahasiswa yang memprotes tidak memadai dan, dengan memanfaatkan kesehatannya yang buruk, menggantikannya di rektorat dengan Giuseppe Lazzati, yang mengikuti garis pemutusan hubungan yang lebih tegas dengan tuntutan pembaruan.

Lorenzo Ornaghi telah menjabat sebagai Menteri Kebudayaan Italia dalam kabinet Monti sejak 16 November 2011. Setelah penunjukan Profesor Lorenzo Ornaghi sebagai menteri, semua kekuasaan dan fungsi yang melekat pada jabatan rektor dipercayakan kepada wakil rektor, prof.

q_src: What was the name of the conference Campbell University's women's basketball team played in from 1994 to 2011?
q_tgt: Apa nama konferensi tempat tim bola basket wanita Campbell University bermain dari tahun 1994 hingga 2011?
a_src: From 1994 to 2011, Campbell University's women's basketball team played in the Atlantic Sun Conference.
a_tgt: Tim bola basket wanita Campbell University bermain di Atlantic Sun Conference dari tahun 1994 hingga 2011.
c_src: The Campbell Fighting Camels women's basketball team is the women's basketball team that represent the Campbell University in Buies Creek, North Carolina. The school's team currently competes in the Coastal Athletic Association (CAA), having moved from the Big South Conference in 2023.== History ==Campbell began varsity play in 1972. They played in the NAIA from 1972 to 1986 before joining Division I in 1986. In their time in NAIA, they made the NCAIAW Division II Tournament once (1982 and the NAIA District 26 Playoffs/Tournament (1983–1986, with a losses in the District 26 title game in 1985 to Pembroke State and 1986 to Wingate). They have played in the Big South Conference since 2011, after playing in the Trans American Athletic Conference (now known as the Atlantic Sun Conference) from 1994 to 2011. In their time in the TAAC/A-Sun, they won a tournament title in 2000 and a regular season title in 2001. In their time in the Big South, they have won the regular season title in 1989, 1991 along with a tournament title in 1989. They have finished as Tournament Runner-up in 1986, 1987, 1990, 1991, and 1992. As of the end of the 2015–16 season, the Camels have a combined overall record of 642–507, with a 187–122 NAIA record and a 465–396 NCAA record.
c_tgt:
Tim bola basket wanita Campbell Fighting Camels adalah tim bola basket wanita yang mewakili Campbell University di Buies Creek, North Carolina. Tim sekolah saat ini berkompetisi di Coastal Athletic Association (CAA), setelah pindah dari Big South Conference pada tahun 2023.

== Sejarah ==
Campbell memulai permainan universitas pada tahun 1972. Mereka bermain di NAIA dari tahun 1972 hingga 1986 sebelum bergabung dengan Divisi I pada tahun 1986. Selama berada di NAIA, mereka berhasil masuk ke Turnamen Divisi II NCAIAW sekali (1982) dan Playoff/Turnamen Distrik 26 NAIA (1983–1986, dengan kekalahan dalam pertandingan perebutan gelar Distrik 26 pada tahun 1985 dari Pembroke State dan pada tahun 1986 dari Wingate). Mereka telah bermain di Big South Conference sejak tahun 2011, setelah sebelumnya bermain di Trans American Athletic Conference (sekarang dikenal sebagai Atlantic Sun Conference) dari tahun 1994 hingga 2011. Selama berada di TAAC/A-Sun, mereka memenangkan gelar turnamen pada tahun 2000 dan gelar musim reguler pada tahun 2001. Selama berada di Big South, mereka telah memenangkan gelar musim reguler pada tahun 1989 dan 1991, serta gelar turnamen pada tahun 1989. Mereka telah menjadi Runner-up Turnamen pada tahun 1986, 1987, 1990, 1991, dan 1992. Hingga akhir musim 2015–16, Camels memiliki rekor keseluruhan gabungan 642–507, dengan rekor NAIA 187–122 dan rekor NCAA 465–396.

c_src: "That's What Love Is For" is a song by Christian music/pop music-crossover singer Amy Grant. It was written by three-time Grammy-Award winner Michael Omartian, Mark Mueller and Amy Grant and produced by Omartian. It was the third Billboard Hot 100 Top 10 pop single  from her 5× platinum-selling album Heart in Motion  and the only one from the album to be released to both Pop and Christian radio.The song topped Billboard Adult Contemporary chart and was No. 1 for three weeks, starting the week of November 29, 1991. It spent a total of 13 weeks in the Top 10 and 32 weeks on the chart overall. The song peaked at No. 7 on the Billboard Hot 100 the week of November 23, 1991  and ultimately spent four weeks in the Top 10. It finished the 1992 Billboard Year-End Hot 100 Singles chart ranked at No. 91.

Lagu ini adalah single pop Top 10 Billboard Hot 100 ketiga dari albumnya yang terjual 5× platinum, Heart in Motion, dan satu-satunya dari album yang dirilis ke radio Pop dan Kristen. Lagu ini menduduki puncak tangga lagu Billboard Adult Contemporary dan menjadi No. 1 selama tiga minggu, dimulai pada minggu tanggal 29 November 1991. q_src: Which data protection regulation in Brazil requires subject access requests to be fulfilled within a specific time frame?
q_tgt: Peraturan perlindungan data mana di Brasil yang mewajibkan permintaan akses subjek dipenuhi dalam jangka waktu tertentu?
a_src: In Brazil, the data protection regulation that mandates fulfilling subject access requests within a specific time frame is the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD), or General Data Protection Law. According to the LGPD, data controllers must respond to subject access requests within 15 days from the date of the request. This regulation is designed to ensure individuals have timely access to their personal data and to uphold their rights regarding data privacy.
a_tgt: Di Brasil, peraturan yang mengatur pemenuhan permintaan akses subjek adalah Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD), atau Undang-Undang Perlindungan Data Pribadi. Menurut LGPD, pengendali data wajib memberikan tanggapan terhadap permintaan akses subjek data dalam jangka waktu tertentu, meskipun undang-undang tidak merinci jangka waktu yang spesifik. Namun, umumnya, praktik yang baik adalah merespons dalam waktu yang wajar, biasanya 15 hari, mengikuti praktik internasional dan saran dari otoritas perlindungan data setempat.
c_src: The right of access, also referred to as right to access and (data) subject access, is one of the most fundamental rights in data protection laws around the world. For instance, the United States, Singapore, Brazil, and countries in Europe have all developed laws that regulate access to personal data as privacy protection. The European Union states that: "The right of access occupies a central role in EU data protection law's arsenal of data subject empowerment measures." This right is often implemented as a Subject Access Request (SAR) or Data Subject Access Request (DSAR).== United Nations ==The aspirational Sustainable Development Goal 16, target 9, calls for the provision of legal identity for all human beings. "In the digital economy, this becomes the right to a digital identity." Such an identity could help in filing subject access requests.== Brazil ==Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD) is its first comprehensive data protection regulation. According to LGPD, subject access requests need to be fulfilled within 15 days.== European Union ==The right of access is enshrined as part of the fundamental right to data protection in the  Charter of Fundamental Rights of the European Union. It is in fact the only one of the practical rights relating to personal data that is listed there.In the GDPR, this right is defined in various sections of Article 15.
c_tgt:
Hak akses, juga disebut sebagai hak untuk mengakses dan akses subjek (data), adalah salah satu hak paling mendasar dalam undang-undang perlindungan data di seluruh dunia. Misalnya, Amerika Serikat, Singapura, Brasil, dan negara-negara di Eropa telah mengembangkan undang-undang yang mengatur akses ke data pribadi sebagai perlindungan privasi. Uni Eropa menyatakan bahwa: "Hak akses menempati peran sentral dalam gudang langkah-langkah pemberdayaan subjek data dalam undang-undang perlindungan data UE." Hak ini sering diimplementasikan sebagai Permintaan Akses Subjek (SAR) atau Permintaan Akses Subjek Data (DSAR).

== Perserikatan Bangsa-Bangsa ==
Tujuan Pembangunan Berkelanjutan aspirasional 16, target 9, menyerukan pemberian identitas hukum bagi semua manusia. "Dalam ekonomi digital, ini menjadi hak atas identitas digital." Identitas semacam itu dapat membantu dalam pengajuan permintaan akses subjek.

== Brasil ==
Undang-Undang Perlindungan Data Umum (LGPD) Brasil adalah peraturan perlindungan data komprehensif pertamanya. Menurut LGPD, permintaan akses subjek harus dipenuhi dalam waktu 15 hari.

== Uni Eropa ==
Hak akses diabadikan sebagai bagian dari hak dasar atas perlindungan data dalam Piagam Hak Asasi Uni Eropa. Faktanya, ini adalah satu-satunya hak praktis yang berkaitan dengan data pribadi yang tercantum di sana.
Dalam GDPR, hak ini didefinisikan dalam berbagai bagian Pasal 15.

q_src: In which decade did Harry F. Sinclair purchase Rancocas Stable?
q_tgt: Pada dekade berapa Harry F. Sinclair membeli Rancocas Stable?
a_src: Harry F. Sinclair purchased Rancocas Stable in the 1910s.
a_tgt: Harry F. Sinclair membeli Rancocas Stable pada dekade 1920-an.
c_src: Rancocas Farm was an American thoroughbred horse racing stud farm and racing stable located on Monmouth Road (County Road 537) in the Jobstown section of Springfield Township, Burlington County,  New Jersey.== Pierre Lorillard IV ==The farm was founded in the 1870s by the wealthy tobacco manufacturer Pierre Lorillard IV (1833-1901) who had a home in the town of Rancocas, now a part of Westampton Township, New Jersey. Lorillard built his stable into one of the premier thoroughbred breeding and training operations in the United States. Lorillard bred Parole, one of the three greatest runners of the 1870s.  In 1881, Lorillard's horse Iroquois became the first American-owned and -bred horse to win a European classic race. Ridden by the champion English jockey, Fred Archer, Iroquois won The Derby then went on to also capture the St. Leger Stakes.== Lily A. Livingston ==On the death of Pierre Lorillard, Rancocas Stable was inherited by Sarah "Lily" Barnes-Allien-Livingston. She sold it in 1919 to Kansas oil industrialist Harry F. Sinclair and moved to Canada where she set up her own breeding and racing operation that would see her inducted into the Canadian Horse Racing Hall of Fame in 2011.== Harry Ford Sinclair ==Harry Sinclair would invest considerable funds to continue the Rancocas breeding and racing success, making it one of the dominant racing stables in the United States during the 1920s.
c_tgt:
Rancocas Farm adalah sebuah peternakan kuda pacu ras Amerika dan kandang balap yang terletak di Monmouth Road (County Road 537) di bagian Jobstown di Springfield Township, Burlington County, New Jersey.

== Pierre Lorillard IV ==
Peternakan ini didirikan pada tahun 1870-an oleh produsen tembakau kaya raya Pierre Lorillard IV (1833-1901) yang memiliki rumah di kota Rancocas, yang sekarang menjadi bagian dari Westampton Township, New Jersey. Lorillard membangun kandangnya menjadi salah satu operasi pembiakan dan pelatihan kuda ras terbaik di Amerika Serikat. Lorillard membiakkan Parole, salah satu dari tiga pelari terhebat tahun 1870-an. Pada tahun 1881, Iroquois milik Lorillard menjadi kuda pertama milik dan dibiakkan di Amerika yang memenangkan balapan klasik Eropa. Dikendarai oleh joki juara Inggris, Fred Archer, Iroquois memenangkan The Derby lalu kemudian merebut St. Leger Stakes.

== Lily A. Livingston ==
Setelah kematian Pierre Lorillard, Rancocas Stable diwarisi oleh Sarah "Lily" Barnes-Allien-Livingston. Dia menjualnya pada tahun 1919 kepada industrialis minyak Kansas, Harry F. Sinclair, dan pindah ke Kanada di mana dia mendirikan operasi pembiakan dan balapnya sendiri yang membuatnya dilantik ke dalam Canadian Horse Racing Hall of Fame pada tahun 2011.

== Harry Ford Sinclair ==
Harry Sinclair menginvestasikan banyak dana untuk melanjutkan kesuksesan pembiakan dan balap Rancocas, menjadikannya salah satu kandang balap dominan di Amerika Serikat selama tahun 1920-an.

q_src: Who contributed to the album Keys to the Kingdom by North Mississippi Allstars?

c_src: Keys to the Kingdom is the sixth studio album by American band North Mississippi Allstars. It was released in 2011 through Songs of the South Records. It features contributions from Mavis Staples, Alvin Youngblood Hart, Spooner Oldham, Gordie Johnson, Ry Cooder, Jim Spake and Jack Ashford. The album peaked at number 175 on the US Current Album Sales, number 46 on the Top Rock Albums, number two on the Top Blues Albums, number 27 on the Independent Albums, number four on the Heatseekers Albums and number 14 on the Tastemakers.== Critical reception ==Keys to the Kingdom was met with generally favorable reviews from music critics. At Metacritic, which assigns a normalized rating out of 100 to reviews from mainstream publications, the album received an average score of 68, based on six reviews.Doug Collette of All About Jazz found out that the album "hearkens back to The North Mississippi Allstars earliest and rootsiest records, but nevertheless represents a marked advance in maturity". AllMusic's Thom Jurek wrote that it "may have been recorded in response to death and birth but it is, more than anything else, a celebration of all that Jim Dickinson held dear in life and music, which are, after all, the same thing". Katie Chow of American Songwriter resumed: "Keys to the Kingdom is both a tribute to and a continuation of the Dickinson musical tradition". David Fricke of Rolling Stone wrote: "deep roots, improvising valor and live-Cream brawn come easily to this trio.
gold_answer_src: Mavis Staples, Alvin Youngblood Hart, Spooner Oldham, Gordie Johnson, Ry Cooder, Jim Spake and Jack Ashford
c_tgt: Kunci Kerajaan adalah album studio keenam oleh band Amerika North Mississippi Allstars. Album ini dirilis pada tahun 2011 melalui Songs of the South Records. Album ini menampilkan kontribusi dari Mavis Staples, Alvin Youngblood Hart, Spooner Oldham, Gordie Johnson, Ry Cooder, Jim Spake, dan Jack Ashford. Album ini mencapai posisi 175 di US Current Album Sales, nomor 46 di Top Rock Albums, nomor dua di Top Blues Albums, nomor 27 di Independent Albums, nomor empat di Heatseekers Albums, dan nomor 14 di Tastemakers.== Tanggapan Kritis ==Kunci Kerajaan mendapat tanggapan positif secara umum dari kritikus musik. Di Metacritic, yang memberikan nilai normal dari 100 untuk ulasan dari publikasi arus utama, album ini menerima skor rata-rata 68, berdasarkan enam ulasan.Doug Collette dari All About Jazz menyatakan bahwa album ini "mengingatkan kembali pada rekaman The North Mississippi Allstars paling awal dan paling bernuansa akar, tetapi juga menunjukkan peningkatan kedewasaan yang nyata". Thom Jurek dari AllMusic menulis bahwa album ini "mungkin telah direkam sebagai tanggapan atas kematian dan kelahiran, tetapi lebih dari segalanya, album ini adalah perayaan atas semua yang Jim Dickinson anggap penting dalam hidup dan musik, yang pada akhirnya adalah hal yang sama". Katie Chow dari American Songwriter menyimpulkan: "Kunci Kerajaan adalah penghormatan sekaligus kelanjutan dari tradisi musik Dickinson". q_src: What term is used in South Africa to describe someone who obtains government contracts to facilitate outsourced services?
q_tgt: Istilah apa yang digunakan di Afrika Selatan untuk mendeskripsikan seseorang yang memperoleh kontrak pemerintah untuk memfasilitasi layanan outsourcing?
a_src: In South Africa, the term "tenderpreneur" is used to describe someone who obtains government contracts, often to facilitate outsourced services, typically through leveraging political connections. It is a portmanteau of "tender" (referring to the bidding process for government contracts) and "entrepreneur." This term often carries a negative connotation, suggesting that the individual might be exploiting their connections for personal gain rather than through genuine entrepreneurship or merit.
a_tgt: Di Afrika Selatan, istilah yang sering digunakan untuk mendeskripsikan seseorang yang memperoleh kontrak pemerintah untuk memfasilitasi layanan outsourcing adalah "tenderpreneur." Istilah ini merupakan gabungan dari kata "tender" dan "entrepreneur," dan biasanya digunakan dalam konteks kritis untuk menggambarkan individu yang mendapatkan keuntungan dari jaringan politik atau hubungan dekat dengan pejabat pemerintah untuk memenangkan kontrak.
c_src: In South Africa, a tenderpreneur is a person in government or the private sector who obtains private or government tenders and contracts to facilitate outsourced services.  The word tenderpreneur is a portmanteau of "tendering" and "entrepreneur". Some commentators believe that this practice might give rise to a kleptocracy as a deviant mutation of a democracy if left unchecked. In this regard a kleptocracy is defined as the condition arising when a political elite manipulates the three arms of government (legislative, executive and judicial) with the intention of capturing resources that will enrich that elite, a general phenomenon known as elite capture.Tenderpreneurship is often accomplished by overpricing and/or shoddy workmanship and/or excessive 'under the table' advances termed "commissions".The Star, a South African newspaper, describes a tenderpreneur as "someone politically well-connected who has got rich through the government tendering system". In January 2010, South African Communist Party leader Blade Nzimande called for transparency in the awarding of tenders, saying "let's be bold, let's go and promote small entrepreneurs and defeat tenderpreneurs, those who steal." The case involving the Gupta family and their close ties to the administration of president Jacob Zuma can be classified as tenderpreneurism.
c_tgt: Di Afrika Selatan, tenderpreneur adalah seseorang di pemerintahan atau sektor swasta yang memperoleh tender dan kontrak swasta atau pemerintah untuk memfasilitasi layanan outsourcing. Kata tenderpreneur adalah gabungan dari kata "tender" dan "pengusaha". Beberapa komentator percaya bahwa praktik ini dapat menimbulkan kleptokrasi sebagai mutasi menyimpang dari demokrasi jika tidak dicegah. Dalam hal ini, kleptokrasi didefinisikan sebagai kondisi yang muncul ketika elit politik memanipulasi tiga cabang pemerintahan (legislatif, eksekutif, dan yudikatif) dengan tujuan merebut sumber daya yang akan memperkaya elit tersebut, sebuah fenomena umum yang dikenal sebagai penjarahan elit. Tenderpreneurship sering dilakukan dengan harga yang berlebihan dan/atau pengerjaan yang buruk dan/atau uang muka "di bawah meja" yang berlebihan yang disebut "komisi". The Star, sebuah surat kabar Afrika Selatan, menggambarkan tenderpreneur sebagai "seseorang yang terkoneksi secara politik dengan baik yang telah menjadi kaya melalui sistem tender pemerintah". Pada Januari 2010, pemimpin Partai Komunis Afrika Selatan Blade Nzimande menyerukan transparansi dalam pemberian tender, dengan mengatakan "mari kita berani, mari kita promosikan pengusaha kecil dan kalahkan tenderpreneur, mereka yang mencuri." Kasus yang melibatkan keluarga Gupta dan hubungan dekat mereka dengan pemerintahan presiden Jacob Zuma dapat diklasifikasikan sebagai tenderpreneurism.

q_src: What type of health care group is St John of God Health Care?
q_tgt: Jenis kelompok layanan kesehatan apakah St John of God Health Care?
a_src: St John of God Health Care is a not-for-profit Catholic healthcare organization. It operates a range of services including hospitals, home nursing, disability services, and social outreach programs across Australia and New Zealand. The organization is committed to providing holistic care that aligns with its values based on the teachings of the Catholic Church.
a_tgt: St John of God Health Care adalah kelompok layanan kesehatan nirlaba yang berasal dari Australia. Mereka menyediakan berbagai layanan kesehatan, termasuk rumah sakit, layanan kesehatan mental, layanan untuk lansia, serta berbagai layanan komunitas lainnya. Dijalankan berdasarkan nilai-nilai Katolik, organisasi ini berfokus pada penyediaan perawatan yang berpusat pada pasien dan berfokus pada kualitas layanan.
c_src: St John of God Bendigo Hospital is a 167-bed private hospital located in central Victoria.St John of God Health Care acquired Mt Alvernia Mercy Hospital in February 2005, renaming it St John of God Bendigo Hospital.  The private hospital services the City of Bendigo and Central Victoria.St John of God Bendigo Hospital is a division of St John of God Health Care, a Catholic not-for-profit health care group, serving communities with hospitals, home nursing, and social outreach services throughout Australia, New Zealand and the wider Asia-Pacific region. Currently the hospital is partially non-functional, and struggles to be viable. An entire ward is unused and the hospital is on unsure footing financially.== Facilities ==The 167-bed hospital has six theatres, one endoscopy suite, a cardiac interventional lab and a critical care/intensive care unit, as well as a hydrotherapy pool and gymnasium.== Services ==Services provided by St John of God Bendigo Hospital include:Medical and surgical careMaternityCardiology and coronary careIntensive careRehabilitationCancer treatmentObstetrics and gynaecologyDay surgeryElective surgeryOutpatient services== Social outreach ==St John of God Raphael Services provides perinatal infant mental health care in Bendigo. Staffed by mental health clinicians, Raphael Services provide free support for parents and families affected by anxiety, depression and other mental health difficulties during pregnancy and in the postnatal period.They services also provide counselling and support for parents undergoing prenatal testing or who have experienced pregnancy loss.
c_tgt: Rumah Sakit St John of God Bendigo adalah rumah sakit swasta dengan 167 tempat tidur yang terletak di Victoria tengah. St John of God Health Care mengakuisisi Rumah Sakit Mount Alvernia Mercy pada Februari 2005, dan mengganti namanya menjadi Rumah Sakit St John of God Bendigo. Rumah sakit swasta ini melayani Kota Bendigo dan Victoria Tengah. Rumah Sakit St John of God Bendigo adalah divisi dari St John of God Health Care, sebuah kelompok layanan kesehatan nirlaba Katolik, yang melayani masyarakat dengan rumah sakit, perawatan rumah, dan layanan penjangkauan sosial di seluruh Australia, Selandia Baru, dan wilayah Asia-Pasifik yang lebih luas. Saat ini rumah sakit tersebut sebagian tidak berfungsi, dan kesulitan untuk bertahan. Seluruh bangsal tidak digunakan dan rumah sakit berada dalam kondisi keuangan yang tidak pasti.== Fasilitas ==Rumah sakit dengan 167 tempat tidur ini memiliki enam ruang operasi, satu ruang endoskopi, laboratorium intervensi jantung, dan unit perawatan kritis/intensif, serta kolam hidroterapi dan ruang olahraga.== Layanan ==Layanan yang disediakan oleh Rumah Sakit St John of God Bendigo meliputi:Perawatan medis dan bedahPersalinanKardiologi dan perawatan koronerPerawatan intensifRehabilitasiPengobatan kankerKebidanan dan kandunganBedah harianBedah elektifLayanan rawat jalan== Penjangkauan sosial ==Layanan St John of God Raphael menyediakan layanan kesehatan mental bayi perinatal di Bendigo. Dikelola oleh dokter kesehatan mental, Layanan Raphael memberikan dukungan gratis bagi orang tua dan keluarga yang terdampak oleh kecemasan, depresi, dan kesulitan kesehatan mental lainnya selama kehamilan dan periode pascapersalinan. Layanan ini juga menyediakan konseling dan dukungan bagi orang tua yang menjalani tes prenatal atau yang mengalami keguguran.

q_src: What did Archer Capital purchase in partnership with the management of Australian Geographic in 1998?
q_tgt: Apa yang dibeli Archer Capital dalam kemitraan dengan manajemen Australian Geographic pada tahun 1998?
a_src: In 1998, Archer Capital, in partnership with the management of Australian Geographic, purchased the Australian Geographic business. This acquisition included the Australian Geographic journal and its related retail chain.
a_tgt: Pada tahun 1998, Archer Capital, bekerja sama dengan manajemen Australian Geographic, membeli perusahaan yang dikenal sebagai Australian Geographic. Pembelian ini meliputi aspek-aspek bisnis seperti publikasi majalah, operasi ritel, dan kegiatan lain yang terkait dengan brand tersebut.
c_src: Archer Capital is an Australian private equity investment firm based in Sydney. It was founded as GS Private Equity in 1996. Archer Capital hosts multiple investment funds which invest in businesses across a wide array of industries and sectors, specifically targeting mid-market leveraged buyouts in Australia and New Zealand.The firm currently owns or co-owns a number of Australian and New Zealand companies including Allity and Craveable Brands. Previous investments include Australian Geographic, Dome, John West Foods, MYOB, Rebel, Supercars Championship and Repco.== Notable investments ==In 1998, the firm partnered with the then-management of Australian Geographic to purchase the business for A$50 million. It was later sold to a consortium including the Myer family.In 2000, Archer Capital gained a 50% stake in Dome coffeehouses, selling for A$20 million in 2003 to Navis. In 2001, Archer was part of a consortium (paying A$30 million) which purchased Repco from Pacific Dunlop, publicly listing the company on the Australian Stock Exchange in 2003.Archer Capital was involved in the purchase of John West Foods from Unilever in 2003.
c_tgt: Archer Capital adalah perusahaan investasi ekuitas swasta Australia yang berbasis di Sydney. Perusahaan ini didirikan sebagai GS Private Equity pada tahun 1996. Archer Capital mengelola beberapa dana investasi yang berinvestasi di bisnis di berbagai industri dan sektor, secara khusus menargetkan pembelian dengan leverage pada perusahaan kelas menengah di Australia dan Selandia Baru. Perusahaan saat ini memiliki atau ikut memiliki sejumlah perusahaan Australia dan Selandia Baru termasuk Allity dan Craveable Brands. Investasi sebelumnya termasuk Australian Geographic, Dome, John West Foods, MYOB, Rebel, Supercars Championship, dan Repco.== Investasi Penting ==Pada tahun 1998, perusahaan bermitra dengan manajemen Australian Geographic saat itu untuk membeli bisnis seharga A$50 juta. Bisnis tersebut kemudian dijual kepada konsorsium termasuk keluarga Myer.Pada tahun 2000, Archer Capital memperoleh 50% saham di kedai kopi Dome, dijual seharga A$20 juta pada tahun 2003 kepada Navis. Pada tahun 2001, Archer menjadi bagian dari konsorsium (membayar A$30 juta) yang membeli Repco dari Pacific Dunlop, mencatatkan perusahaan tersebut di Bursa Efek Australia pada tahun 2003.Archer Capital terlibat dalam pembelian John West Foods dari Unilever pada tahun 2003.

q_src: According to some writers, which ancient city is equated with Parrhasia?
q_tgt: Menurut beberapa penulis, kota kuno manakah yang disamakan dengan Parrhasia?
a_src: According to some writers, the ancient city of Parrhasia is equated with the city of Lycosura. Lycosura is often considered one of the oldest cities in Arcadia, Greece, and is sometimes linked to Parrhasia in various historical texts.
a_tgt: Beberapa penulis kuno menyamakan kota kuno Parrhasia dengan Lycosura, yang terletak di wilayah Arcadia di Yunani. Sumber-sumber kuno sering kali memiliki variasi dalam penamaan dan pengaitan tempat, sehingga penting untuk merujuk pada teks atau penulis spesifik untuk rincian lebih lanjut.
c_src: Parrhasia (Ancient Greek: Παρρασία) was a city of ancient Arcadia, in the region of Parrhasia. It was mentioned by Homer in the Catalogue of Ships in the Iliad. It was said to have been founded by Parrhasus, a son of Lycaon, or by Pelasgus, son of Arestor. Some writers equate the city with Lycosura.
c_tgt: Parrhasia (Yunani Kuno: Παρρασία) adalah sebuah kota kuno di Arkadia, di wilayah Parrhasia. Kota ini disebutkan oleh Homer dalam Katalog Kapal di Iliad. Dikatakan didirikan oleh Parrhasus, putra Lycaon, atau oleh Pelasgus, putra Arestor. Beberapa penulis menyamakan kota ini dengan Lycosura.

q_src: What is the Planck mass denoted by in the equation for the Vainshtein radius?
q_tgt: Apa yang dilambangkan dengan massa Planck dalam persamaan jari-jari Vainshtein?
a_src: The Planck mass in the equation for the Vainshtein radius is typically denoted by \( M_{\text{Pl}} \). The Vainshtein radius is a concept used in modified gravity theories, like massive gravity, to describe a scale below which modifications to gravity (such as those introduced by a massive graviton) become negligible. The Planck mass is a central constant in these equations, often appearing in the context of comparing gravitational interaction strengths.
a_tgt:
Massa Planck dalam fisika teoretis adalah konstanta fundamental yang penting dalam berbagai persamaan yang menggambarkan interaksi gravitasi kuantum. Dalam konteks teori modifikasi gravitasi seperti teori Vainshtein, massa Planck sering muncul sebagai parameter yang menghubungkan skala kuantum dan gravitasi klasik.

Ketika kita membahas jari-jari Vainshtein, yang merupakan karakteristik dari pendekatan modifikasi gravitasi tertentu untuk menyelesaikan masalah terkait dengan teori medan skalar dalam kehadiran gravitasi, massa Planck digunakan untuk menskala atau menetapkan batas antara domain di mana efek modifikasi gravitasi menjadi signifikan dan domain di mana gravitasi Newtonian atau relativitas umum berlaku.

Secara khusus, jari-jari Vainshtein mengacu pada jarak di mana efek dari modifikasi teori gravitasi seperti teori gravitasi massive atau teori galileon mulai tampak. Dalam persamaan jari-jari Vainshtein, massa Planck sering digunakan untuk menghitung skala di mana teori-teori ini akan mulai berlaku, menyeimbangkan antara kontribusi gravitasi dan interaksi skalar lainnya.

Oleh karena itu, massa Planck dalam persamaan jari-jari Vainshtein melambangkan batasan skala yang mengaitkan gravitasi kuantum dengan modifikasi gravitasi dalam teori-teori tersebut. Massa Planck memberikan cara untuk menganalisis seberapa kuat interaksi gravitasi dalam skenario ini dan memberikan dasar untuk menilai dampak potensial dari teori gravitasi modifikasi pada skala kosmik atau astrofisika tertentu.

q_src: What was the name of the protagonist in the Prizzi novels?
q_tgt: Siapa nama protagonis dalam novel Prizzi?
a_src: The protagonist in the Prizzi novels, written by Richard Condon, is Charlie Partanna. He is a key character in the series, starting with "Prizzi's Honor."
a_tgt: Protagonis dalam novel "Prizzi's Honor" karya Richard Condon adalah Charlie Partanna.
c_src: Prizzi's Honor is a satirical crime novel by Richard Condon published in 1982.  It is the first of four novels featuring the Prizzis, a powerful family of Mafiosi in New York City. In all four novels the protagonist is a top member of the family named Charlie Partanna. It was adapted into a successful film of the same name. Prizzi's Honor was followed in 1986 by Prizzi's Family, which is a prequel story. Chronologically, the events in Prizzi's Honor are followed by the story of Prizzi's Money, which was the fourth and final Prizzi novel published, and also Condon's last work.== Plot summary ==The opening lines of the New York Times review summarize the complexities of the novel:CHARLEY PARTANNA, underboss of the Prizzi crime family, has a problem. He's just bumped off a traitor in Vegas who'd fleeced the organization to the tune of $720,000 - and now he's discovered that his new girlfriend, Irene, was the dead man's wife. As if that weren't enough of a headache, Charley's also learned that she's been augmenting her income as a tax consultant by working as a freelance hitter, and that she's now been offered a contract by a family rival to do the number on him. What a business for a woman!
c_tgt: Prizzi's Honor adalah novel kriminal satir karya Richard Condon yang terbit pada tahun 1982. Ini adalah yang pertama dari empat novel yang menampilkan keluarga Prizzi, keluarga Mafiosi berpengaruh di New York City. Dalam keempat novel, protagonisnya adalah anggota penting keluarga bernama Charlie Partanna. Novel ini diadaptasi menjadi film sukses dengan judul yang sama. Prizzi's Honor diikuti pada tahun 1986 oleh Prizzi's Family, yang merupakan cerita prekuel. Secara kronologis, peristiwa dalam Prizzi's Honor diikuti oleh kisah Prizzi's Money, yang merupakan novel Prizzi keempat dan terakhir yang diterbitkan, dan juga karya terakhir Condon.== Ringkasan Plot ==Kalimat pembuka dari ulasan New York Times merangkum kompleksitas novel ini:CHARLEY PARTANNA, wakil bos keluarga kriminal Prizzi, memiliki masalah. Dia baru saja menyingkirkan seorang pengkhianat di Vegas yang telah menipu organisasi sebesar $720.000 - dan sekarang dia mengetahui bahwa pacar barunya, Irene, adalah istri orang yang sudah mati itu. Seakan itu belum cukup memusingkan, Charley juga mengetahui bahwa Irene telah menambah penghasilannya sebagai konsultan pajak dengan bekerja sebagai pembunuh lepas, dan bahwa dia sekarang telah ditawari kontrak oleh saingan keluarga untuk menghabisi Charley. Benar-benar bisnis yang aneh untuk seorang wanita!

q_src: In which country was AFN Bremerhaven located?
q_tgt: In quale paese si trovava AFN Bremerhaven?
a_src: AFN Bremerhaven was located in Germany. AFN stands for American Forces Network, and AFN Bremerhaven was one of the network's broadcasting stations serving U.S. military personnel stationed in and around Bremerhaven, Germany.
a_tgt: AFN Bremerhaven si trovava in Germania. AFN sta per American Forces Network, un servizio di trasmissione destinato principalmente alle forze armate statunitensi di stanza all'estero. Bremerhaven è una città situata nel nord della Germania.
c_src: AFN Bremerhaven was originally an "Armed Forces Radio and Television Service" (AFRTS) station. (AFRTS, worldwide, is now also known as "American Forces Network" or "AFN").  The Bremerhaven affiliate station was located in northern Germany. At the time, it was part of the "American Forces Network - Europe."  AFN Bremerhaven began broadcasting in 1945, originally as AFN Bremen.The station began operating just after World War II ended in Europe.  It was originally established in the north German city of Bremen in allied-occupied Germany as a small AM radio station with an AM repeater transmitter also broadcasting the station's signal in Bremerhaven, Germany, a port city on the Weser River near the entrance to the North Sea located just north of Bremen.== Military mission ==The radio station's mission was to provide information and entertainment to members of the American forces who were based in that part of northern Germany.  After World War II, the small north German US occupied area was originally known as the "Bremen Enclave", and it was an "American island" located in the portion of the newly formed West Germany that was originally occupied and controlled by British forces, (The British Occupation Zone of West Germany).== History ==Just after World War II, the port city of Bremerhaven was one of the major ports from where American forces embarked for return to the United States after fighting in the Second World War; later, the port brought US military personnel, their families, military equipment, as well as food and goods for the rebuilding of Europe to Germany via ships from the US.  Many of these shipments were, in part, in support of the Marshall Plan designed to assist and re-build war-torn Europe. Later, in the 1960s, and thereafter, most personnel movement was done via air travel.
c_tgt: AFN Bremerhaven era originariamente una stazione "Armed Forces Radio and Television Service" (AFRTS). (L'AFRTS, in tutto il mondo, è ora noto anche come "American Forces Network" o "AFN"). La stazione affiliata di Bremerhaven si trovava nella Germania settentrionale. All'epoca, faceva parte dell'"American Forces Network - Europe". AFN Bremerhaven iniziò le trasmissioni nel 1945, originariamente come AFN Bremen. La stazione iniziò a operare subito dopo la fine della seconda guerra mondiale in Europa. Fu originariamente fondata nella città nord-tedesca di Brema nella Germania occupata dagli alleati come una piccola stazione radio AM con un trasmettitore ripetitore AM che trasmetteva il segnale della stazione anche a Bremerhaven, in Germania, una città portuale sul fiume Weser vicino all'ingresso del Mare del Nord situata poco a nord di Brema. == Missione militare == La missione della stazione radio era di fornire informazioni e intrattenimento ai membri delle forze armate americane che erano di stanza in quella parte della Germania settentrionale. Dopo la seconda guerra mondiale, la piccola area occupata dagli Stati Uniti nella Germania settentrionale era originariamente nota come "Enclave di Brema", ed era un'"isola americana" situata nella parte della Germania occidentale appena formata che era originariamente occupata e controllata dalle forze britanniche, (la zona di occupazione britannica della Germania occidentale). == Storia == Subito dopo la seconda guerra mondiale, la città portuale di Bremerhaven fu uno dei principali porti da cui le forze americane si imbarcarono per tornare negli Stati Uniti dopo aver combattuto nella seconda guerra mondiale; in seguito, il porto portò in Germania personale militare statunitense, le loro famiglie, equipaggiamento militare, nonché cibo e beni per la ricostruzione dell'Europa tramite navi dagli Stati Uniti. Molte di queste spedizioni erano, in parte, a sostegno del Piano Marshall progettato per assistere e ricostruire l'Europa devastata dalla guerra. Successivamente, negli anni '60 e da allora in poi, la maggior parte del movimento del personale è avvenuta tramite viaggi aerei.

q_src: What was the position of August Joseph Donatelli's plane during World War II when it was shot down?
q_tgt: Qual era la posizione dell'aereo di August Joseph Donatelli durante la seconda guerra mondiale quando è stato abbattuto?
a_src: August Joseph Donatelli served as a waist gunner on a B-17 bomber during World War II. When his plane was shot down, he occupied this position, which is located on the side of the aircraft, typically midway between the nose and the tail. Waist gunners were responsible for defending the aircraft from enemy fighters approaching from the sides.
a_tgt:
August Joseph Donatelli, meglio conosciuto come Augie Donatelli, fu un aviatore americano durante la Seconda Guerra Mondiale. Nel 1943, il suo bombardiere fu abbattuto durante una missione sul fronte europeo. Non esistono dettagli pubblicamente disponibili sulla posizione esatta in cui il suo aereo fu abbattuto, ma è noto che fu catturato e trascorse il resto della guerra come prigioniero in un campo tedesco. 

Dopo la guerra, Donatelli divenne un noto arbitro di baseball nella Major League. Se hai bisogno di ulteriori dettagli, ti suggerisco di consultare fonti storiche o documenti militari relativi alle missioni aeree Allied Europe WWII.
c_src: August Joseph Donatelli (August 22, 1914 – May 24, 1990) was an American umpire in Major League Baseball who worked in the National League from 1950 to 1973. Highly regarded for his ability, he was also known for his inclination to eject players and managers quickly and dramatically. He was on the cover of the first issue of Sports Illustrated, with catcher Wes Westrum and batter Eddie Mathews, in August 1954.== Life and career ==Known as Gus to those close with him, Donatelli was born in Heilwood, Pennsylvania, and raised in Bakerton. After enjoying a 14-game career as a minor league infielder in 1938, he served in the Army Air Forces' Eighth Air Force during World War II and spent 15 months as a German prisoner of war after flying 18 missions as a tailgunner on a B-17. Donatelli's plane was shot down during the first daylight raid on Berlin, and he suffered a broken ankle upon parachuting. He began umpiring softball games while a POW before being freed when Soviet troops overran the area. After the war, Donatelli opted for an umpiring career rather than a return to the coal mines near his hometown, and after graduating from Bill McGowan's school in 1946 worked in the Pioneer League in 1946, the South Atlantic League in 1947, and the International League in 1948–49.During his major league career, Donatelli umpired in the World Series in 1955 (outfield only), 1957, 1961, 1967 and 1973. He also officiated in the National League Championship Series in 1969 and 1972, serving as crew chief for the latter series, and in the three-game playoff series to determine the NL champion in both 1959 and 1962.
c_tgt:
Traduzione in Italiano:
August Joseph Donatelli (22 agosto 1914 – 24 maggio 1990) è stato un arbitro statunitense della Major League Baseball che ha lavorato nella National League dal 1950 al 1973. Altamente considerato per le sue capacità, era anche noto per la sua inclinazione a espellere giocatori e manager rapidamente e in modo plateale. Era sulla copertina del primo numero di Sports Illustrated, con il ricevitore Wes Westrum e il battitore Eddie Mathews, nell'agosto del 1954.== Vita e carriera ==Conosciuto come Gus dagli amici più stretti, Donatelli è nato a Heilwood, in Pennsylvania, ed è cresciuto a Bakerton. Dopo una carriera di 14 partite come infielder nelle leghe minori nel 1938, ha prestato servizio nell'Ottava Air Force dell'Esercito durante la seconda guerra mondiale ed è stato per 15 mesi prigioniero di guerra tedesco dopo aver volato in 18 missioni come mitragliere di coda su un B-17. L'aereo di Donatelli è stato abbattuto durante il primo raid diurno su Berlino e, paracadutandosi, ha subito una frattura alla caviglia. Ha iniziato ad arbitrare partite di softball mentre era prigioniero di guerra, prima di essere liberato quando le truppe sovietiche hanno invaso l'area. Dopo la guerra, Donatelli ha optato per una carriera da arbitro piuttosto che per un ritorno nelle miniere di carbone vicino alla sua città natale. Dopo essersi diplomato alla scuola di Bill McGowan nel 1946, ha lavorato nella Pioneer League nel 1946, nella South Atlantic League nel 1947 e nella International League nel 1948-49.Durante la sua carriera nella Major League, Donatelli ha arbitrato nelle World Series del 1955 (solo outfield), 1957, 1961, 1967 e 1973. Ha anche arbitrato nelle National League Championship Series del 1969 e 1972, fungendo da capogruppo per quest'ultima serie, e nelle serie di playoff di tre partite per determinare il campione della NL sia nel 1959 che nel 1962.
